advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Commish in Epstein Files: Tre' Harris + C.J. Stroud for Patrick Mahomes.
Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.4 points a week) and drop Jalen Nailor.

reasons: You're 15-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 26%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 34% of the time with the first-round bye and 22% without it. You get the bye in 33% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 1st of 8 contenders (179.5 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (12th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 26%, 27%, 28%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 26% to 30%, and your lineup comes out 0.2 points a week ahead overall. Tre' Harris + C.J. Stroud add 8.7 points a week for you today, but Patrick Mahomes is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 5,968, get 5,624), and it helps their lineup too (+0.4 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 27% and 28% to 27% and 27%.
You have 3 weeks until the trade deadline.
